description: Deleting the tree's single org-kind node is refused 409 Conflict / SCOPE_NODE_ORG_UNDELETABLE, with the removal never executed. The seeded tree is the org node ALONE — no child, nothing placed at it — so DAT-020's child-emptiness test and DAT-021's reference test are both satisfied and the org rule is the only one that can be answering, which is exactly the independence DAT-022 states.

body.title: Conflict
body.detail: The tree's org-kind scope node cannot be deleted: it is the root every other node and row is placed under, not one node among them.
